title: Nutty Jamaican Peanuts Stew
description: A dense, nutty stew packed with suet, black beans, and roasted peanuts, simmered to perfection with traditional Jamaican spices for a hearty meal-prep dish.
instructions: Heat a large pot over medium heat and add the beef suet. Brown the suet for 5–7 minutes until it develops a deep brown color and releases fat; this step takes place at about 160 °C.
Add the diced onion, minced garlic, carrot, and potato to the pot. Sauté for 3–4 minutes until the vegetables start to soften.
Stir in the minced scotch bonnet pepper, dried thyme, allspice, and curry powder. Cook for 1–2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the cooked black beans and roasted peanuts, stirring to combine. Pour in the vegetable broth, bring to a gentle boil, then reduce heat to maintain a steady simmer around 95–100 °C.
Cover the pot and simmer for 60 minutes, stirring occasionally. The broth should thicken slightly and the beans and vegetables should be tender.
Taste and season with salt and freshly ground black pepper as desired.

Let the stew rest in the pot for 5 minutes before serving. The dish can be portioned into airtight containers for meal prep and stored in the refrigerator for up to 4 days or frozen for longer storage.
